entities.name: Negotiated IMSI offset
entities.description: Information element included by the network when paging timing collision control is supported and the MUSIM UE has requested IMSI offset.

entities.name: Requested IMSI offset
entities.description: Information element included by MUSIM UE in ATTACH REQUEST message to request IMSI offset for paging timing collision control.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure to the network.

entities.name: Network supports paging timing collision control
entities.description: Condition indicating the network has capability for paging timing collision control.

entities.name: MUSIM UE included Requested IMSI offset IE
entities.description: Condition where MUSIM UE has included Requested IMSI offset IE in ATTACH REQUEST message.

relations.description: ATTACH REQUEST message contains the Requested IMSI offset IE when sent by MUSIM UE.
Inclusion of Negotiated IMSI offset IE is guarded by network support for paging timing collision control.
Inclusion of Negotiated IMSI offset IE is guarded by MUSIM UE having included Requested IMSI offset IE in ATTACH REQUEST.
